Predict P(LL) from a beezdiscounting_choice_brms model

Source: R/dd-brms-choice.R
predict.beezdiscounting_choice_brms.Rd

Predict P(LL) from a beezdiscounting_choice_brms model

Usage

# S3 method for class 'beezdiscounting_choice_brms'
predict(
  object,
  newdata = NULL,
  type = c("response", "parameters"),
  level = "subject",
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  draws = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A beezdiscounting_choice_brms object.

newdata

Optional trial-level data (needs rel and delay, or ss/ll columns from which rel is derived).

type

"response" (P(choosing the larger-later)) or "parameters" (per-subject k summaries).

level

"subject" or "population".

probs

Interval probabilities.

draws

Return the draws matrix instead.

...

Unused.

Value

A tibble (or draws matrix).
